title: Experimental and Computational Investigation of Thermal Conductivity in Porous Silicon: Doping-Dependent Performance of Molecular Dynamics and Physics- Informed Neural Networks
title_zh: 多孔硅热导率的实验和计算研究：分子动力学和物理信息神经网络的掺杂相关性能
summary: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。
abstract: Porous silicon (pSi) is a highly promising material for nanoscale thermal management, but predicting its thermal conductivity remains challenging due to complex structure-property dependencies. In this work, we present a comprehensive multiscale investigation of heat transport in pSi, combining experimental gas-microphone photoacoustic (PA) measurements with atomistic Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations and continuum-level Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Mesoporous pSi layers with porosities ranging from 48% to 75% were fabricated via electrochemical etching of highly doped p+-type silicon, and their effective thermal conductivity was experimentally determined. Our findings reveal that the thermal properties are fundamentally governed by the initial substrate doping, which dictates the formation of either isotropic sponge-like or anisotropic columnar morphologies. We demonstrate that MD simulations accurately capture the thermal behavior of heavily doped samples by explicitly accounting for phonon confinement, whereas the PINN approach excellently models percolation and macroscopic heat flux in stochastic networks typical of lightly and moderately doped silicon. By integrating these computational and experimental datasets with literature values, we utilized symbolic regression to derive a generalized analytical expression for the effective thermal conductivity of pSi as a function of porosity and temperature. This hybrid multiscale framework connects nanoscale phonon mechanics to macroscopic thermophysical properties, providing a predictive tool for the design of porous silicon-based thermoelectric and thermal-insulation devices.

title: Extreme temperature gradient drives substantial thermoelectric current in additive manufacturing
title_zh: 极端温度梯度在增材制造中驱动大量热电流
summary: 工程合金中的热电效应通常被忽略，因为它们的塞贝克系数很小。在这里，我们证明这种以材料为中心的假设在增材制造 (AM) 的极端温度梯度下是失败的。在激光粉末床熔融和激光定向能量沉积的代表性条件下，将瞬态电势的原位测量与多物理场模拟相结合。在我们的实验中，我们发现~10⁵–10⁸ K m⁻1的温度梯度在AlSi10Mg熔池中产生~10⁶–10⁸ A m⁻²的电流密度，尽管其塞贝克系数仅为~2 μV K⁻1。这些值匹配或超过热电材料某些条件下的电流密度。
abstract: Thermoelectric effects are commonly neglected in engineering alloys because their Seebeck coefficients are small. Here we show that this material-centred assumption fails under the extreme temperature gradients of additive manufacturing (AM). Combining in situ measurements of transient potential with multiphysics simulations under representative conditions of laser-powder-bed-fusion and laser-directed-energy-deposition.In our experiments we find that temperature gradients of ~10⁵–10⁸ K m⁻¹ generate current densities of ~10⁶–10⁸ A m⁻² in melt pool of AlSi10Mg, despite its Seebeck coefficient of only ~2 μV K⁻¹. These values match or exceed current densities in some conditions ofthermoelectric materials. Additionally, we established a fully coupled thermoelectric magnetohydrodynamic (TEMHD)model that incorporates complete thermoelectric effects, and investigated the influence of thermoelectric source terms on the multi-physics coupling process. The currents are strongly anisotropic and spatially heterogeneous within the melt pool. The resulting Joule and Thomson heat terms locally rival or exceed heat losses from the melt-pool surface, changing regional temperature gradients by ~1–10% and current densities by ~2–15%, whereas the Peltier term remains weak. Although the specific microstructural consequences remain to be established, the magnitude, localization and thermal feedback of thermoelectriccurrents identify them as an inherent non-negligiblecomponent of melt-pool dynamics and solidification in AM, and as a pre-existing electrical background for magnetically or electrically assisted process. Our high‑fidelity TEMHD model provides an effective tool for studying this class of problems.

title: More about Spin-Spin Dipole-Dipole Interactions Contributions to the Shapes of Nitroxide EPR Spectra in Solution
title_zh: 更多关于自旋-自旋偶极-偶极相互作用对溶液中氮氧化物 EPR 光谱形状的贡献
summary: 在这项工作中，获得的实验数据证实了自由基的不成对电子与其自身的 15N 核（DD1）之间的偶极-偶极相互作用对 15N-Tempol 自由基溶液中的 EPR 共振线形状的贡献。人们可能会认为，通过旋转扩散对 DD1 进行随机调制会导致共振频率的谱扩散：DD1 随机翻转氮核自旋的方向，导致电子自旋随机改变频率并从一个超精细组件跳跃到另一个超精细组件。预计会发生光谱扩散。在核自旋与晶格或与其他自由基中的电子相互作用的情况下，或者在核自旋系统内自旋扩散的情况下，这是预期的过程。
abstract: In this work, experimental data were obtained confirming unusual contribution of dipole-dipole interaction between unpaired electron of the radical and its own ¹⁵N nucleus (DD1) to EPR resonance line shapes in solutions of ¹⁵N-Tempol radicals. One might expect that the random modulation of DD1 by rotational diffusion leads to spectral diffusion of the resonance frequencies: DD1 randomly flips the orientation of the nitrogen nuclear spin, causing the electron spin to randomly change frequencies and jump from one hyperfine component to another. Spectral diffusion is expected. This is an expected process in the case of the interaction of a nuclear spin with the lattice or with electrons in other radicals, or in the case of spin diffusion within the nuclear spin system. In this case, the electron spin facilitates flipping of the nuclear spin, and resonant frequency of that electron changes. As Marsh demonstrated, the elementary process is not limited merely to the nuclear spin flip. In addition to the frequency shift, spin coherence of unpaired electron acquires an extra phase of π. It should be noted that a similar effect was previously predicted by Salikhov and experimentally confirmed in studies by Bales and colleagues regarding paramagnetic relaxation associated with the dipole-dipole interaction of unpaired electrons in dilute solutions of nitroxide radicals (DD2). In this work, we present experimental data demonstrating negative interference between contributions of DD1 and DD2 paramagnetic relaxation mechanisms, on the one hand, and paramagnetic relaxation caused by spin exchange during random bimolecular collisions of radicals, on the other. Spin exchange leads to spectral diffusion without π-phase jumps of spin coherence.

title: Multi-Dimensional Structural Fingerprinting for Quantitative Polymorph Comparison: A Comprehensive Topological Analysis of Sulfathiazole, Galunisertib and Aripiprazole Polymorphs
title_zh: 用于定量多晶型物比较的多维结构指纹图谱：磺胺噻唑、Galunisertib 和阿立哌唑多晶型物的综合拓扑分析
summary: 有机分子晶体的多态性给制药和材料科学应用带来了重大挑战，需要稳健的方法来进行定量结构比较。我们提出了一种多维拓扑指纹识别方法，通过五个互补类别来量化结构关系：晶体堆积、分子间相互作用网络、分子构象、片段取向和空间几何。基于分布的相似性度量可以对结构rev{进行排序和聚类，并且每个描述符都独立于晶胞、空间群设置和笛卡尔坐标系。
abstract: Polymorphism in organic molecular crystals presents significant challenges for pharmaceutical and materials science applications, requiring robust methods for quantitative structural comparisons. We present a multi-dimensional topological fingerprinting approach that quantifies structural relationships through five complementary categories: crystal packing, intermolecular interaction networks, molecular conformation, fragment orientation, and spatial geometry. Distribution-based similarity metrics enable ranking and clustering of structuresrev{, and every descriptor is independent of the unit cell, space-group setting and Cartesian frame.We demonstrate the approach on three pharmaceutical polymorph families: five DFT-optimized sulfathiazole polymorphs, ten experimental galunisertib polymorphs and nine experimental forms of the flexible, partly non-aromatic aripiprazole. Which categories are conserved depends on the molecule. For sulfathiazole, spatial geometry is the most consistent category (0.78--0.86), whereas conformation and interaction networks separate Forms II, III and IV from Forms I and V. For galunisertib, spatial geometry and conformation are the most consistent, crystal packing varies most. For aripiprazole, spatial geometry is much less conserved (0.41--0.74), and the decomposition distinguishes forms that share their packing but not their conformation (Forms I and X) from forms that share their conformation but not their lattice (Forms III, IV and V). The overall similarity agrees with COMPACK cluster matching for sulfathiazole (Spearman ρ=-0.89 with RMSD) and follows the number of matched molecules for galunisertib (ρ=0.44) and aripiprazole (0.67). Compared with the invariant descriptors AMD, PDD and SOAP, the fingerprint identifies the form of 47 sulfathiazole and 21 aripiprazole structures equally reliably and ranks distinct polymorphs closer to COMPACK cluster matching (aripiprazole: ρ=0.67 versus 0.14--0.37), though not to simulated PXRD similarity. Rankings are robust to coordinate perturbations and cutoff choices, except where an H-bond lies at the criterion or few aromatic contacts occur. The framework supports polymorph classification, structural relationship analysis, validation of crystal structure prediction and solid-form screening.

title: Surface Charge Transition Levels and Hole Localization of Dopants in BiVO4(010) Photoanodes
title_zh: BiVO4(010) 光电阳极中掺杂剂的表面电荷跃迁水平和空穴局域化
summary: 钒酸铋 (BiVO4) 是一种基准氧化物光阳极，其性能由表面态决定，但其表面缺陷的热力学和电荷跃迁水平 (CTL) 的特征仍然远不如其体缺陷物理特征。在这里，我们使用介电相关的混合密度泛函理论来计算 BiVO4(010) 上氧空位以及替代 n 型（Mo、W）和 p 型（Ca、Sr）掺杂剂的形成能和 CTL。在阳极操作的富O条件下，Mo和W在V亚晶格上进行取代，对于导带边缘的费米能级，它们比Bi位点高3.3和3.7 eV。
abstract: Bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) is a benchmark oxide photoanode whose performance is governed by surface states, yet the thermodynamics and charge transition levels (CTLs) of its surface defects remain far less characterized than its bulk defect physics. Here we use dielectric-dependent hybrid density functional theory to compute formation energies and CTLs for oxygen vacancies and for substitutional n-type (Mo, W) and p-type (Ca, Sr) dopants on BiVO4(010). Under the O-rich conditions of anodic operation, Mo and W substitute on the V sublattice, which they prefer over the Bi site by 3.3 and 3.7 eV for a Fermi level at the conduction band edge. Surface oxygen vacancies are shallow donors whose ε(2+/0) level lies 0.16 eV below the conduction band and are ionized over almost the whole gap. MoV and WV are deeper donors at 0.51 and 0.58 eV below the conduction band. CaBi is a shallow acceptor 0.02 eV above the valence band, whereas SrBi has no transition within the gap and is ionized at every Fermi level. The two acceptors also place the hole differently, CaBi on the outermost oxygen layer and SrBi in the interior. Because photoanode operation is limited by holes reaching the surface, an acceptor that captures photogenerated holes on the outermost oxygen layer should be more useful for water oxidation than one that leaves them in the interior, which makes CaBi the more promising p-type dopant of the two.

title: Physics-Coupled Task Allocation for Collaborative Robotic Welding of Dissimilar Steel Joints Using an α-Potential Game and a Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate
title_zh: 使用 α 势博弈和物理通知神经网络代理的异种钢接头协作机器人焊接的物理耦合任务分配
summary: 异种钢接头的协作机器人焊接涉及有关任务分配、焊接顺序、热相互作用、能耗和生产时间的耦合决策。传统的基于距离的分配方法没有明确考虑相邻焊接操作可能改变后续操作的热状态和机械响应的事实。本研究提出了一种物理耦合任务分配框架，其中协作焊接机器人被建模为 α 势游戏的参与者，并使用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 代理来评估热机械响应。 α-势公式表示个体效用变化与非相加热相互作用导致的公共势函数变化之间的有限差异。
abstract: Collaborative robotic welding of dissimilar steel joints involves coupled decisions concerning task assignment, welding sequence, thermal interaction, energy consumption, and production time. Conventional distance-based allocation methods do not explicitly account for the fact that neighboring welding operations may modify the thermal state and mechanical response of subsequent operations. This study proposes a physics-coupled task-allocation framework in which collaborative welding robots are modelled as players of an α-potential game and the thermo-mechanical response is evaluated using a physics-informed neural-network (PINN) surrogate. The α-potential formulation represents the bounded discrepancy between individual utility changes and changes in a common potential function resulting from non-additive thermal interactions. A sufficient equilibrium result is established: under a finite feasible strategy space, a global maximizer of the α-potential is an α-Nash equilibrium. Log-linear learning is employed as a stochastic strategy-update mechanism, while finite-time convergence results from the potential-game literature are invoked only for the exact-potential case and under their stated assumptions. The PINN incorporates the transient heat-conduction and mechanical-equilibrium equations into its training objective and provides a reduced-cost approximation of repeated thermo-mechanical evaluations. In the computational study, the proposed framework reduced normalized makespan and energy consumption relative to the distance-driven allocation strategy while simultaneously accounting for residual stress and carbon redistribution. The results indicate that coupling physical response with distributed task allocation can improve the quality of multi-robot welding decisions. The reported numerical values are computational predictions and should be independently validated experimentally before being generalized to industrial welding applications.

title: Q-IDS Bench: Reproducible and Resource-Aware Evaluation of Quantum-Inspired Intrusion Detection Across Five Network and IoT Datasets
title_zh: Q-IDS Bench：跨五个网络和物联网数据集对量子启发的入侵检测进行可重复和资源感知的评估
summary: 经常报告非常高的 IDS 分数，但一项精度测量本身并不能表明检测器在不同的分割、预处理管道或部署预算下是否保持可靠。 Q-IDS Bench 通过在五个数据集上对九个量子启发的入侵检测系统 (IDS) 配置进行基准测试来解决这个问题，所有数据集都在经典硬件上实现。在拟合预处理之前，数据被分为训练集、验证集和测试集，并且每个实验都使用五个随机种子重复。通过加权 F1、AUPRC、MCC、误报率、攻击召回率和模型端推理延迟来评估性能。
abstract: Very high IDS scores are frequently reported, but one ac curacy measure does not by itself show whether a detector will remain reliable under a different split, preprocess ing pipeline, or deployment budget. Q-IDS Bench exam ines this issue by benchmarking nine quantum-inspired intrusion-detection system (IDS) configurations on five datasets, all implemented on classical hardware. The data are divided into training, validation, and test sets before fitted preprocessing, and each experiment is repeated with five random seeds. Performance is assessed with weighted F1, AUPRC, MCC, false-positive rate, attack recall, and model-side inference latency. The best weighted-F1 values range from 98.86% to 99.95%, but the leading architecture depends on the dataset. The key result is therefore not a universal winner but the reproducibility of the compari son: model rankings are dataset-specific, and hybridisation alone does not guarantee better performance. The study provides a baseline for future comparison with genuine quantum machine learning (QML) implementations.
